title: Ventilatory efficiency of the exercise: A detailed method report
author: Muller

steps.title: Set up CPET equipment
steps.instruction: Connect the Vmax encore 229® (Viasys Healthcare, Yorba Linda, USA, 2012) to the electric braked cycle ergometer ViaSprint (Viasys Healthcare, Yorba Linda, USA, 2012) and enable digital oxygen saturation and electrocardiography monitoring via Cardiosoft® (EUA, 2012).

steps.title: Choose ramp rate for subject
steps.instruction: Determine the incremental power increase: for heart‑failure subjects use 10–20 W·min⁻¹; for healthy subjects use 25 W·min⁻¹.

steps.title: Perform incremental exercise
steps.instruction: Run the subject on the cycle ergometer using the selected ramp rate until maximal symptom‑limited performance is reached.

steps.title: Collect breath‑by‑breath data
steps.instruction: Record breath‑by‑breath respiratory variables throughout the exercise test.

steps.title: Exclude outlier breaths
steps.instruction: For each breath, calculate the local average and its standard deviation; discard any breath whose value exceeds three times (3 ×) the standard deviation of the local average.

steps.title: Compute five‑breath moving averages
steps.instruction: Apply a five‑breath moving average to the cleaned data and use these averages to determine the VCO₂‑log‑VE slope and the VE/VCO₂ (ηVE) analysis.
